message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_mediastinal_shift_direction", "description": "When interpreting chest X-rays with significant unilateral opacity, explicitly verify the direction of mediastinal shift to distinguish between volume loss (collapse) and space-occupying lesions (mass/effusion).", "applicable_conditions": "Any chest imaging task involving unilateral lung opacity, consolidation, or effusion where differential diagnosis includes atelectasis versus mass effect.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If a chest X-ray shows significant unilateral opacity: (1) Do not rely solely on classifier scores for 'Effusion' or 'Consolidation'. (2) Explicitly inspect the tracheal position and cardiac silhouette in the image. (3) Determine if the shift is ipsilateral (towards the opacity, suggesting collapse/atelectasis) or contralateral (away from the opacity, suggesting large effusion/mass). (4) Ensure the final report reflects this directional finding before selecting diagnostic options."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
